mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates ultra-accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and housing start decline (HOUST) indicate economic overheating with recession risk, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS grows and HOUST declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth (GDPC1) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) define a late-cycle expansion regime where tightening expectations cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3% and UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek safety.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL inflation above 5% annualized and declining real sales (RSAFS) indicate stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5% and RSAFS declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
